mapper.select:
/* 후보정용어관리 (8060) */ /* AdminWordCorrectionMapper.selectList */
SELECT A.AI_INPT_WORD_SRNO AS AI_INPT_WORD_SRNO ,A.AI_INPT_GRP_CD AS AI_INPT_GRP_CD ,A.AI_INPT_WORD_TXT AS AI_INPT_WORD_TXT ,A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD AS AI_INPT_GRP_CD_CC ,CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '110' THEN '공통' WHEN B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '241' THEN '수입' WHEN B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '242' THEN '수출' END AS AI_INPT_GRP_CD_NM ,B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
FROM CSPD117TI A LEFT JOIN (SELECT AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM ,AI_INPT_GRP_CD ,AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD IN ('241', '242') AND AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM != '110'
UNION ALL
SELECT AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM ,AI_INPT_GRP_CD ,AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD IN ('241', '242') AND AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM = '110' AND ROWNUM = 1) B ON A.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = B.AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM WHERE 1=1
AND B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = #{inptAtmcBizDscd}
AND A.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = #{inptAtmcBizDscd}
AND A.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = #{schInptItem}
AND AI_INPT_WORD_TXT LIKE '%'||TRIM(UPPER(#{schText1}))||'%'
ORDER BY B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(A.AI_INPT_WORD_TXT, 4000, 1) /* 2026.07.31 MODIFY */
ORDER BY DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(A.AI_INPT_WORD_TXT, 4000, 1) DESC /* 2026.07.31 MODIFY */
ORDER BY AI_INPT_GRP_CD_NM ASC, AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM ASC, /* AI_INPT_WORD_TXT ASC */ DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(A.AI_INPT_WORD_TXT, 4000, 1) ASC /* 2026.07.31 MODIFY */
mapper.insert: /* 후보정용어관리 (8060) */ /* AdminWordCorrectionMapper.insertWord */ INSERT INTO CSPD117TI ( AI_INPT_WORD_SRNO, AI_INPT_GRP_CD, AI_INPT_WORD_TXT, AI_INPT_WORD_INF_NM, AI_INPT_RMRK_TXT, TRN_LOG_SRNO, LST_DB_CHG_ID, LST_DB_CHG_DTM ) VALUES ( (SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_WORD_SRNO)+1 FROM CSPD117TI), #{aiInptGrpCd}, TRIM(UPPER(#{aiInptWordTxt})), null, null, #{trnLogSrno}, #{lstDbChgId}, (SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF6') FROM DUAL) )
